subject: Renewal ops checklist + QBR calendar cascade
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Kara Jensen <kara@bitwell.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-11 09:12 PDT
Subject: Renewal ops checklist + QBR calendar cascade

Hi Kara — looping you in with the team to get our renewal kickoff in motion. Bitwell’s contract is up for renewal on 2026-09-30; you flagged interest in a throughput uplift and a one-year term shift at our last exec sync. To keep this tight I put together an ops checklist and a proposed calendar cascade (QBR + procurement + legal windows). See attached: renewal-checklist.xlsx.

High-level timeline (proposal):
- Week of 2026-07-26: Technical onboarding pre-call (capacity/tuning)
- Week of 2026-08-02: QBR / commercial review (mutual stakeholders)
- Week of 2026-08-09: Procurement & legal review; target DocuSign send by 2026-08-13
- 2026-09-01: Final internal approvals and capacity ramp window

Key asks from Bitwell:
1) Confirm the decision-maker(s) who will sign (name & email).
2) Confirm QBR availability windows (preferred days/times).
3) Flag any additional compliance evidence your procurement team will need.

Ops checklist (owners):
- SOW & pricing confirmation — Ben Carter (sales)
- Technical readiness + burst pool sizing — David Kim (product) / TBD from Bitwell
- Mutual Action Plan & timing — Marissa Cole (CS)
- Legal redlines & procurement coordination — Karthik Iyer (sales ops)

Preliminary capacity note: based on current usage we recommend a +30% committed throughput uplift and a short-term burst pool to cover seasonal peaks. David will propose specifics after the tech pre-call.

If the timeline above looks okay, I’ll cascade calendar invites and Marissa will kick off the MAP. Proposed QBR blocks: Aug 3/4/5 (US morning windows). Let me know which block works for your team.

Thanks —
Naomi Feldman
Senior Renewal Lead | Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0124

Attachment: renewal-checklist.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Kara Jensen <kara@bitwell.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Bitwell Procurement <procurement@bitwell.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-11 12:47 PDT
Subject: Re: Renewal ops checklist + QBR calendar cascade

Thanks Naomi — this timeline is helpful. Quick answers:
- Signing authority: Michelle Park (VP Finance) — michelle.park@bitwell.com. Procurement will coordinate contract intake.
- QBR availability: Aug 4 (anytime PST) is best for our stakeholders; Aug 5 morning is a fallback.
- Compliance asks: procurement will request SOC2 scopes and data retention details — I’ve cc’d procurement.

On capacity: we are definitely interested in the +30% uplift and need clarity on how burst billing is applied. Can David or someone from product share a short write-up before the tech pre-call?

We’ll need the SOW no later than Aug 6 so procurement has time for review. Happy to take an early SOW draft today if available.

Best,
Kara Jensen
Head of Platform | Bitwell
kara@bitwell.com | +1 (206) 555-0199

Thanks everyone — I booked the QBR block for Aug 4, 2026 09:30–11:00 PT and sent a calendar cascade to Bitwell (you should have an invite Kara; if not I’ll re-send). Attendees on our side: Naomi, Ben, David, me. Kara — please confirm Michelle and any procurement/legal reps who should be on the call.

I also uploaded a draft Mutual Action Plan to the shared drive and attached a working copy here (mutual-action-plan.xlsx). Key MAP milestones:
- SOW review by Bitwell: due 2026-08-06 (owner: Bitwell procurement)
- DocuSign send: target 2026-08-13 (owner: Ben/Legal)
- Capacity pre-check (internal): 2026-07-30 (owner: David)
- Final sign & commit: 2026-08-20 (owner: Michelle Park / Bitwell)

David — can you confirm the burst billing example (monthly cost delta for a 30% uplift + 60-day burst) so Kara/procurement can evaluate the budget impact? If you can drop a short write-up in the shared drive by end of day Jul 13 that would be great.

Kara, if everything above looks correct I’ll leave the SOW review action with your procurement team and re-run the calendar cascade to include Michelle and legal. Small ask: please reply-all with the names/emails for anyone outside Michelle who should be added to invites.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
